item.title: This Redditor has built a stained glass-style panel for their gaming PC with a 'magnificent and luxurious animal' on it and it is indeed magnificent and luxurious
item.content:encoded: "It required a lot of effort, focus, and patience."

item.title: Fortnite's V-Bucks are about to get more expensive because 'the cost of running Fortnite has gone up a lot'
item.content:encoded: Epic says running a game like Fortnite costs a lot of money, and somebody's gotta cover it.

item.title: DLSS 4.5 Dynamic Multi Frame Generation is coming to Nvidia App beta users on March 31, bringing on-the-fly 6x frame gen switching to RTX 50-series owners
item.content:encoded: It worked pretty well when I saw an early version at CES, so here's hoping for a smooth launch.

item.title: Nvidia's RTX Mega Geometry system will be sprucing up the forests of The Witcher 4, making for some lush-looking ray traced trees to go Witcher-ing within
item.content:encoded: A missed opportunity to call it Tree Tech, if you ask me.

item.title: Resident Evil Requiem is one of the few games to use GPU data decompression but it's a bit hit and miss as to whether your GPU will ever actually use it
item.content:encoded: It's a puzzle worthy of being in a Resident Evil game.

item.title: This year's Future Games Show Spring Showcase has a dense game-per-hour hit rate and airs everywhere: Here's how to catch it
item.content:encoded: Nicer weather, longer days, lots of games.

item.title: Until Dawn remake studio is officially dead, a year after laying off nearly its entire staff
item.content:encoded: Final Girlzette.

item.title: The Resident Evil 2 Remake's fanmade VR mode with a full-body sim rig is sick—but I doubt I'll ever have the cash to enjoy its immersive frights
item.content:encoded: Save me, Leon!

item.title: Anthropic is suing the US government for blacklisting it and it's calling in support from Google and OpenAI
item.content:encoded: Claude in the middle.

item.title: Where to find the terminals and tagged containers to complete Protect/Destroy 4 in Marathon
item.content:encoded: Processing, Airfield, and then off to Flight Control.

item.title: Resident Evil Requiem director confirms 'extra story content' is in the works: 'It will take some time so we ask for your patience'
item.content:encoded: I would like even more Leon please and thank you.

item.title: The Slice of Life Minecraft add-on has become my new obsession after I realised I just needed a break from the mines
item.content:encoded: Make Minecraft a cosy game.

item.title: Deadlock's latest update brings some huge movement buffs like jumping mid slide and 30% increased air control—it's a lot cooler than it sounds
item.content:encoded: A win for the cowards.

item.title: How to make your very own semiconductor-class cleanroom in a wooden shed and build your own chips, well kinda
item.content:encoded: Knocking up a cleanroom isn't as hard as you might think, the rest of the job, however...

item.title: DRAM maker SK hynix has validated its next-gen LPDDR6 which would be great news for handheld PCs, except that the targeted market is AI devices
item.content:encoded: Lots more performance and way better power efficiency, but destined to be rarer than pixie dust.

item.title: Fallout 3 Remastered toy listing pops up on pre-order website, and we sure are nearly at Oblivion Remastered's 1-year anniversary, aren't we?
item.content:encoded: "Fallout 3 Remastered"? That could mean anything.

item.title: Phison CEO says 'both money and inventory are insufficient' as NAND prices continue to climb at an astronomical rate
item.content:encoded: More bad news for us mere mortals.

item.title: Corsair Sabre V2 Pro Wireless CF review
item.content:encoded: A carbon fibre mouse for an eye-watering price.

item.title: This shady Amazon listing for a 1.1 TB laptop actually uses the cloud for 1 TB and it's only included for a year
item.content:encoded: The real storage is a measly 128 GB.

item.title: WoW: Midnight's new Prey mechanic is the coolest system the MMO's added in a while, but it needs to be meaner—even on lower difficulties
item.content:encoded: The hunter… mostly doesn't become the hunted.

item.title: Intel has released the SDK for XeSS 3 so hopefully it won't be long before Arc GPU owners get in on native multi frame gen action
item.content:encoded: Until then, you'll just have to use the override option.

item.title: Arc Raiders is handing out loadout refunds for last week's server issues: 'This outage impacted a large number of players, so we are making an exception'
item.content:encoded: There are two new haircuts, too.

item.title: As the Marathon player count discourse reaches peak stupidity, Warframe and Overwatch devs speak up in solidarity: 'This is big unemployed, maidenless behavior'

item.title: All Sailor Piece codes for March 2026: Money, Rerolls, and Gems
item.content:encoded: All active Sailor Piece codes for money, rerolls, and gems.

item.title: For the first time in years, there are no blockchain gaming talks at GDC
item.content:encoded: NFTs are out, generative AI is in at this year's Game Developers Conference—though much of the industry isn't on board with that, either.

item.title: Playing Slay the Spire 2 and Esoteric Ebb on my ROG Ally all weekend turned me into a happy lump of swaddled gamer joy
item.content:encoded: And now I must ask: What are you playing on your handheld gaming PC?

item.title: Valve facing second, class-action lawsuit over loot boxes
item.content:encoded: The consumer lawsuit comes just over a week after a similar suit filed by the state of New York.

item.title: 3 months after revealing his debut project at The Game Awards, Yakuza creator Toshihiro Nagoshi loses NetEase funding for his studio
item.content:encoded: Nagoshi Studio is trying to find someone to step into the breach, but so far it's had no luck.

item.title: Bungie snuck a bunch of Halo guns into Marathon
item.content:encoded: The "CE" Tactical handgun. Oh they're not even hiding it.

item.title: Blizzard wants Diablo 4's outrageous damage numbers to mean something again in Lord of Hatred, so it's letting you crank the difficulty up to near-impossible levels: 'It's going to be really f*cking hard'
item.content:encoded: Finally, something to use those big numbers on.

item.title: Steam game listing achieves knockoff singularity by aping Pokémon, Zelda, and even Overwatch designs with a shamelessness Palworld could only dream of
item.content:encoded: I don't feel good.

item.title: Valve says Steam users downloaded 100 exabytes of games in 2025, and are averaging 274 petabytes of installs and updates every day

item.title: One of my favorite Daedalic point-and-click adventures is free on Steam, and a pile of others have been marked way down

item.title: Meta's latest legal wheeze is to insist that pirating books is fair use, actually

item.title: If you miss the old NBA Jam games, this new Harlem Globetrotters game looks like a slam dunk
item.content:encoded: The Globetrotters are celebrating a century of basketball swagger with a new game.

item.title: Microsoft's CEO insists that Xbox, 'at its best, lifts the entire company' and that it will 'always' invest in gaming
item.content:encoded: The future looks green?

item.title: Samsung's new 1440p gaming monitor sports a ridiculous 600 Hz refresh rate but that's nothing compared to the 1040 Hz it can do in 1080p mode
item.content:encoded: And if you prefer pixels over performance, how about a 6K gaming monitor?

item.title: Battlefield 6 was 'the biggest launch in franchise history.' 6 months later, EA is laying off people who made it
item.content:encoded: "Battlefield remains one of our biggest priorities."

item.title: Mode claims its upcoming Encore keyboard refresh 'delivers our most satisfying typing experience to date' and has a neat new mounting system to boot
item.content:encoded: It sounds and looks nice. I'm just afraid of the potential price point.

item.title: Cyberpunk 2077 redemption complete: You can now literally crap yourself to death with an alarmingly well-thought-out mod
item.content:encoded: Oh. Well. Good.

item.title: Bungie has learned its lesson about vaulting content in Destiny 2 and won't be so cruel with Marathon: 'It doesn't matter when you join'

item.title: This creator shoved a Framework inside of a 2006 MacBook: 'A reimagined classic, that's only a little bit janky'

item.title: Modder helps Sony unwittingly beat Valve to the punch: 'I ported Linux to the PS5 and turned it into a Steam Machine'

item.title: I've somehow created Cthulu's own cursed Wingdings with this vibe-coded tool that promises to create fonts from your own handwriting
item.content:encoded: I think it says 'the squiddy one was here'?

item.title: Still humming with life 21 years later, Konami's Master of Epic is a wonderful time capsule of the experimental early MMORPG era

item.title: Banquet For Fools is a CRPG like no other and the most interesting thing I've played this year, and between it and Esoteric Ebb, roleplaying fans are eating great right now
